_readme: The session list the scaled Gemini linkography/network run operates on.
Edit `sessions` to change what gets run -- `gemini_scale.py` reads this file and
nothing else. An entry may be a bare session id string or an object with `id`;
`role` and `why` are documentation only and do not affect the run, except that
role == 'focal' excludes a session from the spot-check sample by default (the two
focal sessions were already read edge-by-edge during validation).
Session ids are the `outputs/<conf>/output_<id>` directory names; conference and
short label are derived from the id, so nothing else needs updating.

selection.pool: 54 of 162 annotated sessions passed all six eligibility criteria
design: Both focal sessions pass the criteria unchanged -- the gate does not exclude the pair the method was validated on.
Outcome contrast: 5 sessions where >=2 people from the room teamed up with each other, 5 where none did (the has_teams framing on deck slide 26).
Conference spread: all 8 conferences represented, so a finding is not a 2020NES artifact.
Comparability: every session is inside the focal pair's range on speakers (8-13 vs 11/11), idea utterances (40-62 vs 58/47) and length (126-207 utterances vs 139/162).
Groundedness: nearest_prior share 3-32%, i.e. at or below NES_S10's 30%, the worst case the validation actually read through.

sessions.why: Validated session A. 3 in-room teams, 1 funded. Spread participation, no dominator.
Validated session B. 0 in-room teams (9/10 teamed up elsewhere). One dominant hub.
Same conference and day as NES_S3, most funded teams of any eligible 2020NES session (3 teams / 2 funded). Strongest links of the set: 31% named, 14% nearest_prior.
2021CMC representative. Teams formed but none funded (1/0), separating 'formed a team' from 'got funded'. Best-grounded links in the pool: 31% named, 10% nearest_prior.
2021MZT representative. 2 teams, both funded -- the highest funded rate in the set. Dense idea stream (61 idea utterances from 9 speakers).
2022MND representative, and the only year not otherwise covered. 2 teams / 1 funded, 36% named links.

2021ABI representative. No in-room teams. NOTE: the only ABI session clearing the material floor -- ABI sessions carry a median 26 idea utterances vs 46 overall, so ABI is thinner than the rest and this session sits at the top of its conference, not the middle.
2021MND representative. No in-room teams, and near-zero fallback (3% nearest_prior) -- a no-team session whose links are about as trustworthy as this method gets.
2021SLU representative. No in-room teams with 12 speakers and 36% named links -- a well-attended, well-grounded negative case.
2021NES representative. No in-room teams. Highest fallback share of the eight (32%), deliberately kept in as the stress case for caveat (A).
